name: Hierarchical Feature Initialization
definition: A method to initialize latent feature grids $F_l$ at level $l$ by leveraging optimization results from previous coarser levels ($F_{1:l-1}$), reducing computational cost compared to optimizing high-dimensional features from scratch.
summary: Hierarchical Feature Initialization reduces computational cost by using a learned encoder to map residuals from prior levels to current features, rather than using zeros or random values.
